g.text: spoken replies: pause at the wake word, the reply
on the room's speaker (MQTT -> bridge -> VLC), resume.
No reply when music starts or under bedroom white noise
setup / nightly training, not per command
Marathi fallback: only when speech-to-phrase hears nothing
Wake word and speech-to-text run on xero,
not the satellite (original ESP32: no on-device wake word;
microWakeWord needs an ESP32-S3 with PSRAM).
The satellites have no speaker: replies play on the
Pi's jack (bedroom) and xero's Bluetooth speaker (living room).
